name: Homeland Nickel Inc.
summary: Homeland Nickel Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the acquisition, exploration, evaluation, and development of mineral properties. It explores for copper, gold, and nickel deposits. The company operates in Canada and the United States. The company was formerly known as Spruce Ridge Resources Ltd. and changed its name to Homeland Nickel Inc. in May 2024. Homeland Nickel Inc. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
